study type: secondary analysis of a cross-sectional chart review study
outcome: receipt of follow-up appointments at discharge
cohort: Children and adults aged 2-54 years who were hospitalized for acute asthma across 18 states were included in this study.
finding: Many hospitalized patients, particularly adults, received only nebulizer-SABA and were less likely to receive individualized action plans or follow-up appointments, highlighting missed opportunities to transition to MDI-SABA delivery and provide self-management education.
